reviews.text:
I cannot say enough good things about this roofing company CLC, out of Coppell, TX.  They stood by us for over six months dealing with our insurance company, navigating delays, paperwork, and constant back-and-forth—and they never gave up. (I almost did)! Throughout the entire process, they were professional, persistent, and incredibly patient. Especially my main contact, Logan H. He was super professional and responsive the entire time.
Most importantly, they did everything they promised and the owner Chad, said they would do. Communication was clear, expectations were met, and the quality of work was excellent. It was clear they truly advocated for us and cared about getting the job done right.

If you’re looking for a roofing company that is honest, dependable, and willing to go the extra mile—especially when insurance is involved—I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Eric S

reviews.text: CLC truly delivered on my roofing job. Michael and his team worked to ensure that the insurance adjuster had all the pertinent information necessary regarding the damage to my roof. Justin and the roofing crew arrived on time, was well organized, thorough and extremely efficient. My roof was replaced from start to finish in just under 8.5 hours. Working with the CLC team was a great experience and thanks to their hard work, I now have a beautiful new roof on my house! I highly recommend CLC roofing company!
reviews.author: Katie Stellar

reviews.text:
As a first-time home owner, I was dreading having to get my roof repaired after some storm damage.
Jaime with CLC Roofing made the experience completely painless.
He worked directly with my insurance company to handle all of the details.
He was able to get my entire roof replaced, including new decking, shingles, and gutters for my home as well as my workshed out back.
I would recommend CLC to everyone I know that needs roofing work done.
Best experience ever.
Also, thanks to Ben, who worked with Jaime to make sure everything was done perfectly and quickly.
1000% recommend CLC for any roofing repairs that you might need done.
reviews.author: Scot Pfeiffer

reviews.text: Had hail damage from the June 2, 2025 storm.  Logan was great to work with from start to finish.  We were able to maximize dollars from the insurance to get the work completed.  Quality was excellent. In particular the flashing work was amazing.  During the project we discovered the Chimney needed to be recovered with stainable wood.  They did that work the day of the roof install and the project was completed smoothly.   Great company, great communication.  I would not hesitate to use them again for roofing or other needs.
reviews.author: RORY MCCRADY

reviews.text:
We contacted CLC Roofing after a major hail storm. They came highly recommended and we needed an expert in not just roof repair but roof and property restoration. The finished product is second to none and looks great. Everything was done exactly as we agreed upon. Jill did a fantastic job helping us along the way with insurance negotiations and decoding their paperwork so we could actually understand it!! Jill and the whole team at CLC Roofing do a great job from start to finish and listen to the customers requests very closely. When the time came to do the work and replace the roof, the process was smooth and done on-time. Cleanup was thorough and the crew was very careful as they worked.
Overall, great experience and I will contact CLC Roofing without delay if I have another roof repair project! Thanks to all at CLC Roofing for a job well done!!
reviews.author: Cb Smith

reviews.text: Logan from CLC Roofing offered to inspect my roof, which had sustained weather damage but had not been replaced, and I had not been paying attention to it. I am glad I listened to him. He handled everything wonderfully, including working with the insurance company to get the claim approved and completing all the work (gutters, window screens, roof, etc.). Thanks to Logan, everything proceeded smoothly, and the quality of the work is excellent. I would highly recommend Logan and CLC Roofing. In fact, I recommended them to a friend, who then also had the work done through them and is very happy with the process and outcome.
reviews.author: S. Sabby

reviews.text: I've worked with CLC in the past and they did a great job. I needed a small repair on my roof.  Andy fit me in, sent me a great quote.  Got the job scheduled and completed.   His tech did a great job, very friendly, courteous- organized.  Great job and I highly recommend.   Thank you, Rick Winter
reviews.author: Rick Winter

reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about my experience with CLC Roofing! From start to finish, the entire roof replacement process was handled with professionalism, efficiency, and care. The crew did an outstanding job—my new roof looks fantastic and the workmanship is top notch.

I especially want to give a huge shout out to Jill, whose customer service was absolutely exceptional. She went above and beyond to keep me informed every step of the way, answered all of my questions with patience and clarity, and truly made me feel like a valued customer. Jill’s responsiveness and attention to detail made what could have been a stressful project an incredibly smooth and positive experience.

If you’re looking for a reliable roofing company that delivers high-quality results and genuinely cares about their customers, CLC Roofing is the one to choose. I couldn’t be happier with the results or the service I received!

- John E.
reviews.author: John Erskine

Jill and the Team were able to strategically plan the scope of work, upgrade my shingle to a Class 4 with High Impact Ridge, qualifying me for a discount on my insurance premium and costing me zero out of pocket.

I called Jill who sent two gentlemen within the hour to check it out and find the leak. We called our insurer (S.F.) and had them come out to inspect the damage, they claimed that the roof was fine and cut us a check for around $2500 for the ceiling and fence/window screen repair. reviews.text: CLC Roofing replaced our roof, chimney cap, damaged gutters, window screens, small metal roofs, and fence stain after recent storms. Jill Sweeny was the Director for our project. She did a great job organizing and scheduling work, advocating for us with insurance, and following up on all work done. The crews were  professional and did quality work. They even went the extra mile to add shields to direct water correctly for the gutters (shown in pictures). We were very pleased with the work done a

Jill Sweeny and the team at CLC Roofing did an amazing job on replacing my roof, and on securing an additional $15,500 towards the necessary repairs to my property.

Jill and the Team were able to strategically plan the scope of work, upgrade my shingle to a Class 4 with High Impact Ridge, qualifying me for a discount on my insurance premium and costing me zero out of pocket.

While it took my insurance company over 4 months to settle my claim, Jill was always on top of the situation. She was in

Logan was extremely helpful coordinating the work that was done. Was able to source the material needed to replace several metal roof panels and fixed a leak left behind by previous contractor. Highly recommend! (Our dog apparently loved them too!)

Last year CLC Roofing did a great job replacing our roof after hail damage in April.  During the torrential we had a couple of weeks ago, I noticed a leak in my master bathroom apparently coming from the shower roof vent.  I called Jill who sent two gentlemen within the hour to check it out and find the leak.  Within 30 minutes they determined that the roof vent on top of the house had a small defect causing the leak inside the house.  They removed the vent and replaced it within an hour!  Thank

Our family needed some home damage repaired due to a hail/wind storm. We not only had roof damage, but also some interior ceiling damage from water intrusion. We called our insurer (S.F.) and had them come out to inspect the damage, they claimed that the roof was fine and cut us a check for around $2500 for the ceiling and fence/window screen repair. This is the point at which Jill Sweeny with CLC Roofing stepped in and helped us dispute the amount of damage to our home. Thanks to Jill and CLC R
Jill Sweeney  at CLC roofing was great in lining up Jay King to fabricate, deliver and install this custom cover for my chimney. It looks great and they did a great job installing it.

Excellent Experience — Highly Recommend!

I had an amazing experience with CLC Roofing, especially Justin Casey. From start to finish, their team was professional, responsive, and incredibly thorough. They came out quickly to give me an estimate, explained everything clearly, and answered all my questions without pressure.

The crew arrived on time each day and worked efficiently, keeping the area clean and safe. I was especially impressed with the attention to detail — they even spotted and fix

Justin Casey from CLC Roofing is incredibly knowledgeable and easy to work with. He’s been professional, helpful, and took the time to explain everything clearly throughout the roof replacement process. I highly recommend CLC Roofing and will absolutely turn to them again in the future.

Justin Casey at CLC Roofing is great to work with—very knowledgeable when it comes to roof replacements. He answered all my questions clearly and offered fair pricing for the repairs I needed. I highly recommend CLC Roofing and will definitely be using them again in the future.

I had a great experience working with Justin from CLC Roofing. He demonstrated extensive knowledge of roof replacement, took the time to answer all my questions, and offered fair and transparent pricing. The process was smooth from start to finish. I highly recommend CLC Roofing and plan to use their services again in the future.

I had a leak after a bad rain storm and part of my shingles ripped off as well as a fan cracked. Lindsay McKinney helped organize and schedule a roof repair. Her communication was professional and kind. Cost was reasonable, the roofer was timely and professional and did quality work to ensure the job was completed.

Caden Hansen did a thorough roof inspection of our home— providing detailed photos, information and explanation of its condition and issues. He was beyond courteous, professional and knew the products, manufacturers and process well—and communicated clearly and concisely to us. CLC Roofing has earned our confidence and trust with this visit.

Recently had to sell my house and needed a couple of roofing repairs that were found on my third party inspection report. After I spoke with Lindsay and sent my report they scheduled my repairs within a couple of days at a great price! It was a huge stress relieve to get those items done before the new buyers closed on my home.

I recently needed a roof repair before putting our home on the market. Lindsay McKinney was the first person I talked to when I called the company. She was kind and professional and made everything so easy! I am thankful for her patience and understanding and during this time.

My wife and I highly recommend CLC Roofing to all of our friends and family! The staff at CLC Roofing are extremely knowledgeable and friendly! We had a great experience and will be using them in any future roofing ventures we have. Ask for Justin and you won’t be disappointed!!
Justin from CLC roofing is a really nice person. He was very knowledgeable about my roof. He acted in a professional way, and made me feel reassured.  I would recommend him to all my friends.
I had an excellent experience with CLC Roofing. Justin was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to thoroughly explain the roof replacement process. Highly recommend!

Joe replaced our roof in 2023 after a major hailstorm. He closed out our account in 2024 after working diligently with our insurance company. Our roof had 23 solar panels which had to be removed as well as the old roofing.  He worked well with the solar company, which we needed both removal and reinstallation  He did a fantastic job not only with our roof, but also with our insurance company. I would recommend his company, CLC Roofing Southlake, to anyone.  We reused him because he had replaced

We were very impressed with the quality and service we received from CLC Roofing. Justin Casey came and inspected our roods and provided us a very honest observation. Days after we had a hail storm move through. When I reached out to him he told me "I'll be out there later today and can tarp it if needed". I was not expecting him to come the same day, but he did. He covered some minor damage that needed some attention until we permanently fix it. Thank you Justin! We appreciate the timeliness an

Had a great experience working with Lindsay at CLC for our roofing repair needs. She connected me to the project manager after reviewing with me all of our options and we were assisted right away. Great customer service. Highly recommend.

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The detailed, specific content across multiple reviews from different customers strongly indicates genuine experiences. The Yelp discrepancy is common and not indicative of fake reviews. The company demonstrates excellent follow-through on warranty/service issues.
fake_signals: Multiple reviews mention same employee names (Jill, Logan, Justin)

positive_evidence: Sent team within an hour to fix a leak from a defective vent, replaced it at no charge
Stood by customer for over six months dealing with insurance

authentic_signals: Extremely specific project details (insurance negotiations, specific storm dates, crew names, specific repairs like chimney caps, window screens)
Varied writing styles and perspectives (first-time homeowner, repeat customer, detailed insurance stories)
Emotionally authentic language expressing relief and gratitude
High volume (1819 reviews on Angi) suggests established business
BBB accreditation since 2000 with A+ rating
data.discrepancy_explanation: Yelp rating (3.9) is significantly lower than Google (4.95) and Angi (4.6). This is a known pattern where Yelp often has lower ratings for contractors due to different user base and review filtering algorithms. The BBB A+ rating indicates strong complaint resolution.
